what: Section 10 wall-clock budget re-validation with the v1.8 full-SVD default (max_dim=None), on the recsys-and-attach-fix branch.

runs.note: default cadence — the budget condition, run 1
default cadence — the budget condition, run 2 (warm)
stress cadence (8x more aggressive than default) — NOT the budget condition
stress cadence + tiny baseline step — fixed per-emit SVD cost dominates the ratio

verdict: PASS — +7.4% at default settings (every_n_steps=200, realistic batch 16x512) is within the <=10% budget. The full-SVD default (v1.8 F1) eroded the margin from +5.3% (old max_dim=512 subsample) to +7.4% but the budget still holds. The +57%/+525% rows are aggressive-cadence/tiny-batch stress artifacts where the fixed per-emit SVD cost is not amortized.
session_additions_cost: sv_histogram companion scalars reuse the already-shared per-step SVD (negligible); GRAD hook reads and NAMED_PARAM reads are O(param) tensor detaches — none add measurable per-emit cost beyond the pre-existing full-SVD default.
